Here is a sample Semgrep rule in YAML format for the vulnerability-fixing evidence you provided:

```yaml
id: vuln-nodebb-48d14392
title: "Improper Initialization"
description: |
  Improper initialization of Namespaces can lead to potential security risks.
languages:
  - javascript
severity: WARNING
pattern: >
  {
    "name": "improper-initialization",
    "message": "Improper Initialization detected.",
    "file": "src/socket.io/index.js",
    "line": "10",
    "type": "object_create"
  }
metadata:
  tags: ["nodebb", "vulnerability"]
```

This rule will match any object creation using `Object.create(null)` in the file `src/socket.io/index.js` at line 10, which is a common way to avoid prototype pollution and similar issues. The pattern field is a custom pattern that matches this specific behavior.

Please note that you need to adjust the "line" number according to your actual codebase.
